en: Sepia-toned, aged photographic postcard showing a long two‑storey (with partial third storey) brick tenement building in an urban street. The facade has tall rectangular windows with segmental brick arches and simple stone sills. A gas or early electric streetlamp is fixed to the wall. In front of the entrance and along the sidewalk stands a group of about twenty children of various ages with a few women, likely residents or caretakers, dressed in early 20th‑century European clothing. Some adults and children look out from open windows on the upper floors. The street appears cobbled. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the front.
